sources: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10265-5.pdf (The AI Scientist — Sakana AI + Oxford + UBC + Vector, Nature Vol 651 March 25 2026)
_meta.notes: Two scientific discovery automation systems. Spacer (Asteromorph): keyword-graph-based inspiration engine (Nuri AUROC 0.737) + Manifesting Pipeline (Weaver/Sketcher, thesis reconstruction 85.44% overall). The AI Scientist (Sakana AI/Lu et al.): end-to-end ML research pipeline + Automated Reviewer. WORLD FIRST: AI-generated paper passed peer review at ICLR 2025 ICBINB workshop (6.33 avg score on 6/7/6, above 70% accept threshold).

scores._note: Nuri EVAL(p) AUROC 0.737 ± 0.025 (95% CI). Classifies 400 papers (200 high-impact FWCI≥15 vs 200 low-impact FWCI<1). Validates Nuri's ability to find high-potential keyword sets.
152/158 — Logic similarity, Science 75/78 + Nature 47/50 + Others (Nat Methods/Cell/Neuron) 30/30

Pre-cutoff (2017-2024) balanced accuracy 0.69 ± 0.04 — superior to Human (NeurIPS) 0.66

🌍 WORLD FIRST: Fully AI-generated paper passed peer review at top-tier ML conference workshop. Avg of 6/7/6 = 6.33. Above ICBINB workshop acceptance threshold. Workshop accept rate 70%, 43 papers reviewed. Paper would have been ACCEPTED but withdrawn per pre-established protocol. 3 papers submitted total; 1/3 accepted (33%). Approved by ICLR leadership + UBC IRB H24-02652.
